records.review: My Advance debit card was withheld by the ATM at Tesco Orpington on 15 July at circa 14.30 .I reported this position in person at HSBC Orpington within about 20 minutes ,  to whichever team handled “gobbled  up cards “ at ATM’s and secondly at length to HSBS FRAUD . I was told 3/5 working day for delivery of the new card BUT guess what , old card not cancelled much less a new card ordered and it has taken until this morning for HSBC to message me that the new card is available for collection as requested  . This in a nutshell is the position and to say the least , I am dammed upset at treatment as I have been a Client of the bank since 1962 ( via Midland Bank ) so it is simply unacceptable to be treated in the way . I have copious file notes, dates , personnel names and perhaps 5 trips to HSBC in person to understand why there has been this delay . I doubt whether I will hear from HSBC again but glad of the opportunity to vent my displeasure. A.D Masters

records.title: Must do better - horrible bugs
records.review:
I’m new to HSBC, having banked with other UK banks. My impression of this mobile app isn’t a good one.
When doing a transfer, confirmation of payee (COP) throws an error when the validated payee name contains an apostrophe. The input form does not allow the insertion of this character. Other banks permit the use of an apostrophe in a recipient name, and the COP scheme documentation states it’s valid. The app simply delivers a lazy implementation that undermines the purpose of COP.
Additionally, the non-native experience is both ugly and unintuitive. The font sizes are mismatched for the mobile screens.
Overall, the product managers and designers behind this monstrosity would be well advised to research other banking apps and see how far behind this app lags.
